status: post-freeze diagnostic calibration frozen before calibration outputs were opened
trigger: Estimator-bias audit identified that G_adv can have a non-zero finite-sample null expectation and that marginal identity can contain horizontal cell-use information.

calibration_null.destroyed_structure: mapping between session and biological individual identity
preserved: number of retained sessions assigned to each individual label
calibration_null.permutation_algorithm: Randomly permute the multiset of individual-label slots across the fixed retained session blocks. Original label assignment is allowed by chance.
calibration_null.valid_replicate_rule: retain every permutation with at least one evaluable pseudo-individual; report the full eligible-individual-count distribution
calibration_summary: one-sided Monte Carlo tail probability P(null >= observed)

common_cell_reweighting.purpose: Remove marginal identity created only because self and other predictors occupy horizontal cells at different frequencies.
common_cell_reweighting.supported_cells: intersection of self and other conditional-profile cells for the held-out target
common_cell_reweighting.weights: For each self-training session, compute its cell-frequency distribution over supported cells; average these distributions equally across self sessions; renormalize to sum to one.
common_cell_reweighting.score: Mean held-out log self_common_marginal(z) minus log other_common_marginal(z), using exactly the target fixes used by G_cond.
common_cell_reweighting.interpretation: Diagnostic separation of vertical conditional identity from horizontal occupancy weighting; not a replacement primary endpoint.

uncertainty.note: Bootstrap uses the frozen observed set of evaluable individuals and is descriptive uncertainty, not a new significance gate.

after_output: Do not change permutation unit, B, seeds, cell weights, bins, grid, smoothing, or eligibility thresholds.
If observed architecture is compatible with the calibrated null, weaken the manuscript claim.
If it remains extreme, report calibration as robustness rather than reclassifying it as confirmatory.
Do not expand to other taxa until this focal diagnostic is interpreted and a separate cross-panel calibration contract is frozen.
stop_rule.roost_exclusion: Not included in v1 because a biologically defensible roost definition/radius is not yet frozen independently of outcomes.
